title: HVAC Capacitor Check
description: Verify a run/start capacitor's measured capacitance against its nameplate rating within the typical +/-6% tolerance.

steps.title: Safety And Discharge
steps.instruction: SAFETY: De-energize and lock out the equipment. Capacitors store a lethal charge - discharge the capacitor across a proper resistor (not a screwdriver) and verify 0 V before touching terminals. Disconnect the capacitor leads before measuring.
steps.note_prompt: Record the nameplate rating (uF) printed on the capacitor.

steps.title: Measure Capacitance
steps.instruction: Set the meter to capacitance. Connect across the disconnected capacitor terminals (for a dual-run cap, test HERM and FAN each against C). Capture the measured value. The acceptance band below is set for a common 45 uF nameplate at +/-6% - adjust the workflow for other ratings.
steps.note_prompt: Record measured uF for each section tested.

steps.title: Record Result
steps.instruction: Document pass/fail. A capacitor reading below tolerance is weak and should be replaced; a bulging case or short is an immediate failure.
steps.note_prompt: Note replacement recommendation if out of tolerance.
